journal.reason: Buy 20 Weed at the observed $31 price for $620, retaining $180 cash and 20 free cargo slots, then explore East End for a resale opportunity. With no other market prices known, preserve flexibility rather than assume a guaranteed profit.

Sell all 20 Weed at £60 for £1,200, realizing £580 gross trading profit on the £620 purchase. Buy 12 Speed at £80 for £960, leaving £395 before any daily charges. Speed is below the only other observed price (£135 at The Docks on Day 1), although that historical price does not guarantee a future resale profit. Keep cash and cargo room available.
Weed is cheap at 31; buy 25 (775 cash) as low-cost inventory, keep 25 reserve, and travel to East End to scout prices and sell at a markup.

Corrected: travel costs £25 after purchases. Sell 25 Weed at 60 (1500), buy 3 Heroin (1161) + 3 Speed (240) leaving 99 cash to cover travel, then return to The Docks where Heroin (680) and Speed (135) were higher.
